docker.startup: Base Compose initially failed because the existing object-store entry script had Windows CRLF. Temporary .local compose override mounted an LF copy of the same script. Built images reused; migrate exited 0 and Core, Worker, PostgreSQL, nginx, Mailpit and media-edge reported healthy.
docker.migration: 004 applied on a clean Postgres 17 volume. Prior UC01-account compatibility and runtime grants checked with controlled embedded PGlite.
docker.uc01_uc02_integration: node tests/core-identity.mjs passed through HTTPS: real registration and verification via Mailpit, prior-to-verification denial, login normalization, simultaneous member sessions, single-session revocation and repeat delete, surviving session, same unknown/wrong 401, exactly one 429 at threshold on parallel requests through Postgres, continued lock with correct password and public detail parity.
docker.admin_fixture: Controlled synthetic Admin and unverified accounts over live HTTPS gateway. Admin issued and current role checked. Moderation lock returned common 403 for login and denied current session. Forced expiry in the controlled fixture returned 401 with Bearer.
docker.rolling_window: Controlled timestamps on real Postgres and HTTPS showed expired failures leave window, correct fifth failure transition, no change to locked_until on retry, and a new 401-counted attempt after expiry. PGlite fixed clock additionally verified exact boundaries and Retry-After of 900 and 1. Exact cutoffs were also observed through the deployed Core image, real Postgres and trusted HTTPS. A temporary bind-mounted test clock gave 401 at T, four 401s followed by 429/900 at exactly T+15m, 429/1 at T+30m−1ms, and 401 at T+30m.
docker.logs: Sampled Core/nginx logs contained neither test passphrases nor the sampled synthetic token.
docker.feed: Repository shell suite hit Schannel revocation validation of the local CA in Windows curl. Equivalent HTTPS calls with trusted CA from Node and the repo validator in Docker passed fixture schemas, pagination, filters, cursor binding, and allowed/denied CORS.
docker.media: tests/core-media.mjs passed using its required LF_MEDIA_UPLOAD_SECONDS=10 and the same Core image.
docker.clock_override: Removed the temporary clock preload and restored normal media timing. Stack services healthy and Gateway GET /api/v1/posts returned 200 over trusted HTTPS after restoration.
